description: List the chart of accounts in Billy. Use this to find account IDs for bill lines, product revenue accounts, and bank accounts for payments (look for isPaymentEnabled/isBankAccount).

accountNo.description: Filter by account number, e.g. 5211 (applied client-side)

isArchived.description: When true, returns only archived records; when false, only active ones

isPaymentEnabled.description: Only accounts usable as payment/cash accounts

verbose.description: Return the full Billy response. Default false: compact records with key fields only (saves ~90% context)

name: list_accounts
